{{Quote|Damn it, Krupo! I told you how precious my babies are to me, and you go and crash the ship with them in it!|Yarvok, about his pets|<ref name="Codex" />}}
'''Spike''' was a [[Zeldrate]] owned by [[Yarvok]], the leader of the [[Nova Blades]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] group. Yarvok was fond of Spike, calling the pet his "beloved." Yarvok felt the same way about his other Zeldrate, [[Ol' Cronchy]]. [[Krupo]], Yarvok's beast wrangler, lost Spike along with several of Yarvok's other pets after a ship with the pets crashed on the remote [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], angering [[Yarvok]] immensely. Yarvok said he would [[Death/Legends|kill]] Krupo if his missing pets, including Spike, were not returned quickly, as Yarvok believed them to be terrified out alone on Dantooine without him.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Spike was mentioned in the Codex entry for Invasive Species on Dantooine in the [[2019]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] to the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by the company [[BioWare]].<ref name="Codex" />
